claim: Chronography Volume II presents the Chronographers as time travelers who preserve temporal integrity by dispensing Imperfections that nudge events toward outcomes they believe must occur.

Chronography Volume III reports that Sotha Sil reforged fallen followers after the Battle of Mournhold into twelve hundred crystal automatons called the Armour of Oscillating Quartz, who later influenced fabricants to become the Chronographers.
Century Adgran led a Chronographer expedition into Rthamaz to seize and launch the aethership Nzhavananear, suffering severe losses to Dwemer defenses and Aetherion constructs.
The Rthamaz expedition concludes that local centurions/Aetherions and the aethership use Aetherium or starmetal as a power source.
Nzhavananear is an operational aethership able to select destinations including Sotha Sil, Masser, and Tamriel; its records expose multiple Tamriel landing sites.
Aethernautics identifies a destination/cell on Masser as a Reman Era Moon Colony.
The plugin directly contains Chronographer, Chronographer Guard, Chronographer Merchant, and Century Adgran actor records.
